plans.objective: H_C (adjusted-odds-ratio attenuation hypothesis), with H_B embedded as a competing model.**

steps.description: Two-step pipeline. Step 1 (bash_tool): download the UCI Cleveland heart-disease CSV to data/heart.csv and record source_url, download timestamp, bytes, sha256, n_rows, n_cols; verify against the fallback URL if the primary fails. Step 2 (code_tool): write analysis.py that (a) loads data, (b) runs descriptive statistics + missing/outlier handling, (c) fits logistic regression of diagnosis (num≥1) on chest-pain type (cp) with age/trestbps/chol/thalach as covariates — this is H_B (direct association), (d) fits the same model additionally adjusting for exercise-induced angina (exang) and ST slope (slope) as mediators/confounders — this is H_C (attenuation of the cp coefficient), (e) compares the two models via coefficient attenuation Δβ/β_B, likelihood-ratio test, AIC/BIC, and Wald ORs with 95% CIs using t-distribution critical values (n−p df), (f) checks assumptions (VIF, Hosmer–Lemeshow, residual leverage), (g) runs a leave-one-out sensitivity analysis, (h) plots ROC + calibration and dumps results.json + figures/*.png. Then bash_tool to run it, and file_write for report.md.
